verdict.rationale: The evidence contains no first-party CRM migration or import capability. The only related item is a batch-create API method for leads, contacts and companies, which is a developer building block rather than a migration feature, and nothing covers mapping record owners or preserving activity history from another CRM. missing for 10: a documented migration or import tool from other CRMs, preservation of record owners/assignments, preservation of history (notes, activities, timelines), and hands-on corroboration of migration fidelity.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can migrate from another CRM with my records, owners, and history intact

citations.quote: The method allows you to add leads with contacts and a company to your account in batches.
